user.title: ABL eMS Home
user.description: Connection details of the eMS Home unit. The host is the IP address or hostname (e.g. ems-home-12345678); the password is printed on the rating plate. The username is always `admin`.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate eMS Home
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {host} was rejected. Enter the current password from the rating plate.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure eMS Home
reconfigure.description: Change the connection details of {host}. The connection is verified before saving.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the eMS Home unit. Check host and port.
error.timeout: The eMS Home unit did not answer in time. It is a small embedded server – try a longer timeout.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This eMS Home unit is already configured.

init.title: eMS Home options
init.description: The live streams (WebSocket) are what make this integration real-time. Only disable them for troubleshooting.

data.grid_price: Grid price (€/kWh) – empty = no cost calculation
data.pv_price: Value of your own PV energy (€/kWh)

data.min_cycle_power: power at which it counts as charging (kW)
data.min_cycle_seconds: … and for at least this long (seconds)
data.idle_end_seconds: Detect the end of a charge (seconds)

data_description.min_cycle_power: While plugged in, the wallbox reports brief 0,1–0,3 kW samples. A new charge only starts at this power.
data_description.min_cycle_seconds: It has to stay above that for this long, so a short impulse is not a charge.
data_description.noise_floor: Below this everything is standby noise and counts neither as energy nor as cost.
data_description.idle_end_seconds: How long no power may flow before the charge counts as finished – also when the car stays plugged in (full battery). Default: 300 s.

data_description.notify_enabled: Default: off. You can also trigger your own automation on the events ems_home_charging_started / _finished – leave this off then, or you get two messages.
data_description.notify_service: Everything your instance offers – e.g. notify.mobile_app_pixel.
data_description.notify_test: Sends a sample message with the last session's values to the service above as soon as you save. Nothing is written to the device.
data_description.notify_on_start: Short message with mode and price.
data_description.notify_on_finish: Cost, charged energy, duration and grid/PV share.
data_description.notify_channel: Notification channel name, e.g. “Car” or “Solar”. Empty = the phone's default channel. The channel can then be muted on its own in the companion app.
data_description.notify_importance: min = silent, low = quiet, default = normal, high = sound and heads-up, max = full-screen.
data_description.notify_icon: Icon shown in the notification, e.g. mdi:ev-station.
data_description.notify_tag: Messages with the same tag replace each other instead of stacking.

data_description.pv_power_entity: What your solar array produces right now, in W or kW – e.g. sensor.solar_power_total_w. Improves the grid/PV split.
data_description.battery_power_entity: What the battery delivers right now, in W or kW – e.g. sensor.battery_discharge_power_w. Positive while discharging; negative values (charging) are ignored.
data_description.grid_price: Prefilled with 0,35 €/kWh. Clear the field to switch the cost calculation off.
data_description.pv_price: 0 = your own solar energy counts as free
data_description.debug_logging: Writes the state of both streams once a minute and every detail it receives to the log. Useful when the connection drops, but costs CPU and fills the log. Default: off.
data_description.vehicle_entity: Sensor whose state is the car's name – e.g. sensor.current_charging_vehicle. Shown on the card and in notifications.
